eps.t: Car Chases: End of the Road
eps.o: The Air Unit tracks a speeding car. A fleeing SUV hits a dead end and slides down a hill. A suspect crashes and cries. A Grappler stops a chase. TVIs send cars spinning.
A teen ditches a gun. A tense takedown in a park. A suspect is tackled mid-sprint. A brawl over an unflushed toilet. A swampy manhunt. A fence-hopping foot pursuit.
A front-yard fight. An armed felon flees. A balcony brawl. A DV suspect hides. A nervous driver is tased. A bicyclist ignores commands. A cuffed suspect runs.
Bank robbers get caught with guns and masks after a PIT ends a pursuit. A man claims he bought a stolen motorcycle for $800. The Air Unit tracks a stolen car while FHP sets up a TVI.
A suspect sets a door ablaze and attacks with deer antlers. A woman in a stolen car says her grandpa/husband paid for it. Viral video: burglar meets screams and a shotgun.

eps.t: Florida Man Is On The Run
eps.o: Foot pursuit of a teen, 16, yields a BB gun & burglary tools. Traffic stop reveals a gun in a hidden compartment. A machine gun is found in a backpack.
Two men give conflicting stories after a fight over a woman. Feuding brothers clash when both move back in with Mom. A frustrated landlord tries to evict his roommate.
A known drug offender pedals away to keep his meth and gets tackled. A young father-to-be on probation is caught with a firearm. A woman in the midst of a move is caught with crack cocaine.
A doorbell video points to a shooter. A teen's drive-by shooting claim doesn't add up. A woman's story and injuries clash.
A man with a history of hit-and-runs is suspected of doing it again. A man uses his truck to hit his best friend during an argument. A hit-and-run driver flees on foot in Peoria, Arizona.
A suspect flees, taking a wrong turn. A man caught with meth blames an unlocked car door. Meth and a creative meth kit are found.
A former football star flees but is tased. Sons defend their mom, then learn she lied. A passenger can't spell her first name.
A woman caught in a stolen car claims the owner permitted it. Another car from a salvage yard is reported stolen. A man says he bought a stolen car.
In Kansas, a taillight stop leads to a chase and TVI. A cuffed suspect runs but gets tased. A spray-painted car's wild ride ends with spike strips.
Troopers' tinted tag stop ends in a clean TVI. A felon's traffic stop turns into a front-yard wrestling match. A fleeing driver gets teary-eyed.
Pierce County Deputies chase a dope-sick SUV thief. A stolen mini bike is uncovered at an uncle's house. A cyclist admits his breakfast of choice is a gram of heroin.
Green Bay handles feuding roommates. Manatee County deals with noisy, naked housemates. Lafayette responds to fears of a sibling's relapse.
